question: On which occasions is recitation classified as occasional rather than regular?
premises: Recitation on those occasions is called occasional.
inference: Recitation performed on the twelfth day and full-moon day is occasional recitation.
uncertainties: teṣu is masculine plural while referring to feminine occasions; taken as general locative reference.
plain_english: On the twelfth day and on the full-moon day, the recitation is occasional.
